_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 100 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: SLM-93A Spire

description.text: A man-portable air-defense system designed to target enemy aircraft. Requires lock-on before launch, after which missiles will self-guide to the target unless intercepted by countermeasures. Designated targets can be locked-on from further away and lose below-radar protection.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
